bodyMarkus: Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans), neutral international usage: the established Chinese forms of places and institutions. Latin-script names of companies, products and people stay as written. Starter entries from the 2026-11-13 translation experiment's name findings and the 2026-11-12 spike's term findings.

entries.note: Chinese tech press writes AI in Latin letters; 人工智能 for the spelled-out English.
The United States Congress (美国国会 when the country is not clear from context).
Not 泄露 (leak), which is more negative than the English.
